firstPlayerRule: The previous game's winner goes first, or choose the starting player randomly.
clarifications: Turns proceed clockwise. On each turn, take one action; passing is not an option.
With two players, the starter receives one coin and the other player receives two. This applies to both regular setup and the optional two-player card-selection setup.
